scope: Bounded synthetic observations on one host. Full raw timing reports/logs/frozen build trees remain local and ignored; this package retains their identities, exact definitions/caps/sides, all timing projections, original plans and diagnostic sources.
ratioPolicy: Use explicit numerator/denominator labels per report, never execution order. Keep zero and sub-tick samples. A zero denominator yields null/undefined ratio, not a floor; first/early/warm and elapsed/wall/internal timing categories remain distinct.
definitionCatalogPolicy: Every definitionRef resolves to the complete original JSON definition object, including actual iterations/work/caps/profile/limits where authored. Identical definition objects are deduplicated only. Paging driver lacks a definitions array, so its authored expectedSemanticWork plus literal actual iterations/retired work are explicit on each report.

inherited-benchmark.implementation: Frozen scripts/benchmark.mjs and benchmarks/kernels.mjs through scripts/paging-performance.mjs
inherited-benchmark.inputs: Core/complete host manifests before and after each report; benchmark aggregate hash before execution. Frozen artifact/source campaign receipts supplement these checks. No per-import read interception or identical source guard across drivers is claimed.
inherited-benchmark.semantics: Unchanged benchmark reason/retirement/remaining/repeat/event, scalar/context/numeric/RAM/code/resource/unit assertions; independent archived projections retain declared comparison exclusions.
inherited-benchmark.clock: No added per-sample TimeState assertion in this inherited driver.

paging-latency.inputs: Own copied Core/host manifests checked after observation; final kernel hash recorded. No source-before/after or frozen-kernel assertion equivalent to the new clock/gate drivers.
paging-latency.semantics: Inherited literal paging work/reason/resource checks. Actual iterations/retired work and authored limits are retained.

context-reuse.inputs: Own copied Core/host manifests checked after observation; final kernel/fixture hashes recorded. No source-before/after or frozen-kernel assertion equivalent to the new clock/gate drivers.
context-reuse.semantics: Full scalar/context/paging/fast-system/debug/numeric/RAM guards. Each fresh CPU replicate is primed untimed, then two consecutive measured warm batches; nine replicates, not eighteen independent CPU pairs. Current-labeled side additionally checks stable owner identities; all saved warm resource packets show zero compilation/generated bytes.
context-reuse.clock: No per-sample TimeState assertion; separate functional fast-system clock scenarios supply semantic evidence.

paired-gates.semantics: Per-leaf sample semaphore includes factory creation, setup, whole run, full guards and final disposal. Paired architectural/resource/unit flow is compared while recording generated/cache/unit-byte differences.
paired-gates.clock: Current side, or both A/A sides: before+after actual TimeState equals cumulative authored retired instructions, AUX0; predecessor does not require the API.
paired-gates.metric: Retain kernel elapsedMs and wallMs directly inside permit; no queue subtraction.

new-clock.semantics: Fresh CPU per workload; explicit initial TSC100/AUX89abcdef every sample; literal full scalar/time/context/numeric/debug/source/tables/RAM checks outside sample timers. Warm samples preserve cached owners.
new-clock.clock: Actual TSC/AUX readback asserted each sample. No predecessor denominator. Static nominal helper counts are not runtime instrumentation.
new-clock.metric: elapsedMs sums awaited run; wallMs adds loop/timer/result retention; setup/full verification excluded.

counterfactual.inputs: Same frozen candidate Core+own Core instances and unchanged host/benchmark hashes checked before/after; harness hash and global compile-wrapper restoration checked. Exact per-import reads are not intercepted.
counterfactual.semantics: Original benchmark guards and preserved owner metadata; only generated CodeSection changes are admitted. Actual patched module lengths/hashes are separate from unchanged original owner accounting.
counterfactual.clock: Deferred to first post-run public guard access, outside benchmark timing; cumulative literal retirement is asserted except deliberately invalid omit keeps TSC0. Limited to two non-timestamp loops; no shipping future-bias claim.

calibration.inputs: Exact consumed Core bytes are hashed then those same bytes compiled; own frozen host paths plus Core/host/benchmark/harness/plan pre/post guards. Host imports are not individually intercepted.
calibration.semantics: Unchanged frozen measure plus paired snapshots/resource/unit checks. Scoped instantiate observer returns real instances and original CPUs untouched, then reads state pointer/descriptor after factory and restores observer before samples.
calibration.sampling: Eight fresh CPU pairs per cohort/workload in ONE Node process, sharing compiled modules per artifact. Distinct CPU identities do not establish statistical independence across process/JIT/OS/time effects. Five later paired samples per fresh pair; headline aggregates pair-level medians, not forty statistically independent observations.
calibration.placement: Linear-memory pointer geometry only; every observed pointer is1114624/mod64=0. No measured pointer-placement variation or exact physical/native mechanism is established.

projectionExclusions: top-level candidate-only time in gate baseline/current comparisons; AA time remains compared
semanticComparison.ceiling: Intentional generated/cache/unit-byte growth is recorded rather than falsely required equal. Guard methods differ by driver; instrumentation, actual time assertions, sampled timings and source review are distinct evidence.
